title: Alpha brush pack - ten procedural brushes for the mask AND paint brush
description:
Split out of MPI-375 on 2026-08-03 (user). MPI-375 was carrying three separable jobs - the paint layer + tool + Apply, the shared brush plumbing, and this pack - and only the first two unblock MPI-368 (Shapes). The pack has an asset problem the other two do not, so leaving it in made the whole MPI-424 umbrella hostage to it. Originally MPI-401 (closed rejected, merged into MPI-382), then absorbed into MPI-375, now its own card.

TODAY the brush is a hard circle: MaskManager.paint() is a bare ctx.arc() fill, one dab per mousemove event. There are NO brush textures anywhere in the repo - grepped 2026-08-03, nothing. So this card creates brush character from nothing; it does not wire up existing assets.

PROCEDURAL, NOT PNG STAMPS (user decision, 2026-08-03). Ten presets are ten PARAMETER SETS - hardness/falloff, density, scatter, angle jitter, flow - generated in code. No files to author, license, ship or load, and they resample cleanly to any brush size, which a fixed-resolution stamp does not. Authored PNG textures are NOT ruled out forever: keep the dab path able to take a bitmap so real bristle/charcoal stamps can drop in later as extra presets. Do not build that loader now.

WHERE IT LANDS: the shared dab helper MPI-375 extracts (one stampDab(ctx, x, y, r, op, style) plus the dab interpolation along a stroke). That is the whole reason the extraction happens before this card - textures land in ONE function and the mask brush and the paint brush both get them. If this card finds itself editing two dab implementations, the extraction regressed; fix that, do not fork.

UNBLOCKED 2026-08-03 - MPI-375 SHIPPED and the helper EXISTS: js/components/Primitives/MpiCanvas/managers/brushDab.js, exporting stampDab(ctx, x, y, r, op, fillStyle) and strokeDabs(from, to, r, stamp). Both brushes already call it - MaskManager stamps it twice (manual + subtract), PaintManager once - so a preset added inside stampDab reaches both destinations, which is the promise this card was split out to keep. Spacing lives in the same file as DAB_SPACING (a quarter radius). Read docs/painting.md before planning.

--- UNDO CONTRACT ---
This card changes the SHAPE of a dab, not what a stroke is, so the existing gesture wiring (undo.begin at mousedown, undo.commit(takeStrokeBox()) at mouseup) already covers it. The trap is takeStrokeBox(): a scattered or jittered dab paints OUTSIDE the radius the box was grown for, so _growStrokeBox() must account for the preset max scatter or undo will restore a rect smaller than the stroke and leave painted pixels behind. Read docs/masking-undo.md.
acceptance: Ten selectable brush presets, generated procedurally - no image assets shipped
The SAME ten are available to the mask brush and the paint brush, defined once in the shared dab path (MPI-375)
Presets resample correctly across the full brush-size range - no pixelation or falloff drift at large or small sizes
Dab interpolation along a fast drag stays continuous - a scattered brush must not read as a dotted line at speed
A scattered/jittered preset undoes CLEANLY: _growStrokeBox() covers the real painted extent, not the nominal radius (docs/masking-undo.md)
The dab path can still accept a bitmap stamp later - the procedural choice does not wall off authored textures
